# Background
A short description of why this issue/ticket exists. Is this solving an issue that MASA has had in the past? Is this just a cool feature to add? Is this a hotfix for a current issue?

# Implementation Details
This is optional, but if you have preconceived ideas of how you think this issue should be implemented, like prior research, add those details here. Bonus points for every link you add to different resources to look at for whoever is working on the ticket.

# Definition of Done
- [ ] Descriptive Deliverable 1
- [ ] Descriptive Deliverable 2
